blocks.text: Edge computing processing ki taqat ko data ke source (jahan se data aata hai) ke qareeb le aati hai, jis se latency (data ke aane jane mein der) kam hoti aur performance behtar hoti hai. Sirf central data centers par bharosa karne ki bajaye edge computing data ko network ke "edge" (kinare) par, yani data ke source ke qareeb, process karti hai. Is se data ko safar mein kam waqt lagta hai, faisle jaldi hote hain aur data foran (real-time) process hota hai.

Khud chalne wali gariyon (autonomous vehicles) mein edge computing se sensors aur cameras ka data gari ke andar hi process hota hai, is liye gari sarak ki badalti halat par foran jawab deti hai aur hifazat barhti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Top Tip: Edge computing khaas taur par un applications ke liye faidamand hai jinhein foran (real-time) processing aur kam latency chahiye, jaise smart cities, healthcare monitoring (mareezon ki sehat par nazar rakhna) aur factories ki automation.

blocks.prompt: Edge computing ka main faida kya hai (exercise MCQ 1)? Edge computing ke istemal ki misal kaunsi hai (MCQ 14)? Kaunsi technology network ke 'edge' par data process karti hai (MCQ 17)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 1: (b) reduced latency (kam der). MCQ 14: (b) autonomous vehicles (khud chalne wali gariyan). MCQ 17: (a) edge computing.

blocks.prompt: Edge computing kya hai aur data processing ko kaise faida deti hai (exercise short question 3)? Yeh autonomous vehicles ki performance kaise behtar karti hai (short question 8)? Modern technology mein edge computing ki tarraqi aur faide bataiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Edge computing processing ko data ke source ke qareeb le aati hai. Faide: kam latency aur foran faisle; data ko door ke data center tak safar nahi karna parta. Gari mein cameras aur sensors ka data gari ke andar hi jaancha jata hai, is liye woh door ke server ka intezar kiye baghair foran brake ya mor le sakti hai, jis se hifazat barhti hai. Smart cities, patient monitoring aur factory automation bhi isi se chalti hain. (Aam maloomat: network par kam data jane se bandwidth bachti hai, aur kamzor connection mein bhi kaam chalta rehta hai.)

items: Edge computing: processing data ke source ke qareeb; kam latency, real-time faisle.
Misalein: autonomous vehicles, smart cities, healthcare monitoring, industrial automation.
